name: parallel-review
description: Three reviewers on different model families review the same target independently; the conductor synthesizes agreements and disagreements and stops for the operator.

target.description: What to review: a path, a diff, a PR URL, or a document

requirements.description: Path to the requirements or spec the target must satisfy

agents.instructions: Review target: {{inputs.target}}. Requirements: {{inputs.requirements}}. Send the identical brief to all reviewers. Synthesize by listing findings every reviewer agreed on first, then disagreements with each side's evidence.

workflow.description: Conductor writes artifacts/REPORT.md with agreements, disagreements, and a recommendation.
